dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000s7z5](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000s7z5) Magnitude 5.7 earthquake at 53.94 depth occurred on Mar 26 2026 34km E of Foao. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -3.1837 longitude 139.3807. It impacted 177127 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
